Name: Werner 7Ft. Aluminum Scaffold Deck 5507-19USA
Natural: The Werner 7-Foot Aluminum Decked Aluma-Plank serves as a sturdy support structure on job sites with steel scaffolding. The American National Standards Institute (ANSI) gave the plank an A10.8 certification for safety on commercial work sites, which specifies safe compliance with temporary support structures. The Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) provided a safety certification as well. The Werner scaffold deck is made of aluminum for strength and durability. It holds up to 250 pounds of weight, so you can support yourself and your tools at the same time. This aluminum decked plank functions as an interchangeable piece of the Werner scaffolding systems you use every day. Its treads prevent you from slipping while you move and a sturdy installation joint keeps it snug against commercial-grade steel support structures.
